constraints: Python 3 stdlib only (the ffmpeg and ffprobe binaries on PATH may be used via subprocess)
context: Second live-LLM task for the Cipher prototype: a genuinely useful developer tool. The agents may inspect artifacts/test-img1.ppm, artifacts/test-img2.ppm, and artifacts/test-tone.wav as sample inputs (all stdlib-generated). ffmpeg and ffprobe are installed on this machine and on the run_cmd allowlist.
goal: Build artifacts/vidgen.py, a CLI video generator. Given 2+ input images and an audio file, it produces an MP4 slideshow video: each image shown ~3 seconds (configurable via --duration) with a slow zoom motion (Ken Burns style, e.g. ffmpeg zoompan), a crossfade transition between consecutive images (e.g. ffmpeg xfade), and the audio track muxed underneath, trimmed or looped to match the video length. CLI contract: python3 artifacts/vidgen.py --images a.ppm b.ppm --audio tone.wav --output out.mp4 [--duration 3]. --help must print usage information and exit 0. The tool must validate inputs (at least 2 images, audio file exists, ffmpeg present) and exit non-zero with a clear error message on bad input. Write clean, documented code.
